name: premisave-auth-service
description: Premisave authentication service: sign in, sessions, profiles, administrators.

SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE.description: dev, staging or prod. Use staging on the staging app and prod on the production app.

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection string (Heroku has no MongoDB of its own). Use a different database for staging and production.

SPRING_DATA_REDIS_URL.description: Redis address with its password, for example rediss://default:password@host:6379 (Upstash or Redis Cloud). The Heroku Key-Value Store add-on uses a self-signed certificate and does not work here.

JWT_SECRET.description: Must be the same value in the auth and messenger services of the same environment. openssl rand -base64 32

API_KEY.description: Shared key for internal calls. The messenger calls it INTERNAL_API_KEY. openssl rand -hex 32

FRONTEND_URL.description: Address of the website or app, used in email links.

BACKEND_URL.description: Public address of this app, for example https://premisave-auth-staging.herokuapp.com

GMAIL_USERNAME.description: Gmail address that sends the mail.

SECURITY_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Heroku's router addresses may send X-Forwarded-For. Private ranges cover it.

STORAGE_FAIL_ON_UNAVAILABLE.description: Heroku keeps no files between restarts, so home owner document uploads do not last here. Use Render, Fly.io, Coolify or a server for that.
